report_name: Qatar Partners with SignQuantum for Post-Quantum Cybersecurity

identities.name: Qatar's Ministry of Communications and Information Technology (MCIT)
identities.description: The government agency of Qatar leading a collaboration with SignQuantum to explore and implement post-quantum cryptography (PQC) to secure the nation's digital infrastructure and government services.

identities.name: SignQuantum
identities.description: A cybersecurity firm that signed a collaboration agreement with Qatar's MCIT to develop use cases for quantum-resistant digital signatures and other post-quantum cryptography (PQC) technologies.

relationships.source_name: Qatar's Ministry of Communications and Information Technology (MCIT)
